title: A secure case management system for family court advisory teams
summary: An enterprise web application that brings casework and sensitive document handling into one secure, structured workspace for family court advisory and support teams.
problem: Complex casework depends on sensitive documents, reliable workflows and fast access to the right information. Spread across tools, it slowed teams down and made oversight harder.
overview: A secure portal that brings case management and document handling into one system, improving visibility while respecting the access needs of every stakeholder.

built.title: Case workspace
built.detail: One structured place for every case, its status and the people working on it.

built.title: Secure document handling
built.detail: Upload, storage and access to sensitive documents with role-based permissions.

built.title: Workflows
built.detail: Defined steps for casework so nothing depends on memory or email threads.
